items.en: Ukraine reveals RAM-2X loitering munition, credited with 450+ strikes — most against Russian air defenses
items.nl: Oekraïne onthult RAM-2X-loitering munition, toegeschreven aan 450+ treffers — vooral op Russische luchtverdediging
items.sEn: Ukraine has publicly revealed the RAM-2X, an X-winged loitering munition made by Ukrspecsystems that had until now been kept largely out of public view. The drone was unveiled at the MSPO defense expo in Poland in September 2026 after being treated as classified. Ukrspecsystems credits the broader RAM family with more…
